scientific_claim: The real UTF-8 maintenance R3 failure is attributable to monitor confusion from naturally occurring background prediction errors, not to an inadequate correct-repair validation threshold. The unchanged raw error-bucket monitor ranked the true deleted motif first for only one of four frozen targets and as low as rank four, whereas evaluator-only subtraction of canonical background errors ranked the true target first in all four cases. Exact restoration exceeded the frozen 0.20 selected-key validation-gain threshold in all four targets, with minimum gain 0.7153, and never worsened global BPB.
policy_implication: Do not lower the 0.20 retain threshold. The next experiment should replace only raw error-count ranking with a deployable pre-degradation calibration-estimated excess-error monitor; wrong-first/revert/correct-retain semantics and candidate budgets remain frozen.
scope: diagnostic attribution on immutable real UTF-8 bytes; no intervention policy change authorized by this experiment
